notes: CryptoPunkin is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 PUNKINS to msg.sender once. The token has no subsequent minting, burning, transfer fees or privileged administrative functions. No application contracts are deployed. The opening pool price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply; pool.initialPrice records provenance only.
